papers.title_en: DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning
papers.authors: Yuxiang Zeng, Kun Xie, Yang Wang, Jigang Wen, Xiaocan Li, Guangxing Zhang, Gaogang Xie, Jiannong Cao
papers.evidence: 以架构属性预测器降低神经架构搜索成本
papers.tldr: 神经网络架构可视为带操作标签的有向无环图，边方向决定计算流，但现有架构属性预测器多把方向仅当作局部结构线索，导致表示不充分。为此提出 DTA-GT，一种方向与拓扑感知的图 Transformer，在节点初始化、全局谱编码、成对交互与特征更新四个阶段贯彻编码器级方向一致性。在 NAS-Bench-101 与 NAS-Bench-201 的精度和延迟预测上，有限预算下稳定优于序列、GNN、Transformer 及混合预测器。消融与 Magnetic 谱对照表明增益来自各方向感知阶段的协同，为架构 DAG 表示提供了有效设计原则。
papers.abstract_en: Architecture attribute predictors reduce the cost of neural architecture search by estimating accuracy or latency from a small set of evaluated candidates. The key difficulty is that neural architectures are operation-labeled DAGs: edge direction defines computational flow, but existing predictors often treat direction as a local structural cue. We propose DTA-GT, a Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer based on encoder-wide directional consistency, which preserves directed computational semantics across node initialization, global spectral encoding, pairwise interaction, and feature update. DTA-GT realizes this principle with direction- and topology-aware node initialization, Magnetic Laplacian spectral encoding, direction-dual structural attention, and a Direction-Sensitive MoE-FFN. Across accuracy and latency prediction on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DTA-GT consistently outperforms representative sequence-, GNN-, Transformer-, and hybrid predictors under limited-budget settings. Ablations and Magnetic spectral controls show that the improvements come from coordinated direction-aware stages and edge-orientation-sensitive spectral information, while mechanistic diagnostics confirm that the modules exhibit the intended directional behavior. These results support encoder-wide directional consistency as an effective design principle for architecture DAG representation.

papers.title_en: Connection between MP and DPP for Mean-Field Stochastic Optimal Control Problems
papers.authors: Guangzhi Cui, Tianyang Nie, Guangchen Wang
papers.evidence: 连接最大值原理与动态规划原理的最优控制理论
papers.tldr: 针对系数同时依赖状态过程与其分布的一般平均场随机最优控制问题，研究一般最大值原理与动态规划原理之间的内在联系。通过将值函数与最大值原理中的伴随方程建立对应关系，给出二者之间的连接机制，并证明一般平均场随机验证定理。所得结果统一了两类最优性刻画，为求解平均场控制问题提供可验证条件，并用若干显式例子说明其适用性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper deals with the optimal control problem for the general mean-field stochastic differential equations, in which the coefficients depend on both the state process as well as on its law. We focus on the connection between the general maximum principle and the dynamic programming principle for such a control problem. We establish the relationship between the value function of the mean-field optimal control problem and the adjoint equations in the maximum principle. We also give a general mean-field stochastic verification theorem. Some examples are solved explicitly to illustrate our results.

papers.authors: David González-Martínez, Philipp Nazari, T. Konstantin Rusch, Shiwei Liu
papers.evidence: 超越残差相加式跳连的深度聚合统一框架
papers.tldr: 残差连接仅靠逐层相加传递信息，而mHC与AttnRes等深度聚合虽更强却缺乏统一视角。本文把跨深度表示混合视为记忆存取，提出Depth Memory框架统一描述PreLN、mHC与AttnRes，并给出Linear Depth Memory：用递归最小二乘回归实现深度信息检索，维护残差、线性联想记忆与逆协方差三流。配套硬件感知实现降低激活内存与访存。在400M和1.5B规模上，LDM困惑度最低且零样本精度有竞争力，为深度聚合提供了可扩展的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections propagate information through a network by additively accumulating layer outputs. Recently proposed alternatives, such as Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), instead use more expressive depth aggregation mechanisms that improve language modeling performance at scale. In this work, we consider the mixing of representations over depth as a problem of storing and retrieving information across layers. Formalizing this perspective, we introduce Depth Memory (DM), a unified framework that describes the standard pre-layer-norm (PreLN) transformer, mHC, and AttnRes in terms of streams that carry representations through the network. One such stream, for example, could be an explicit memory stream that is queried to enrich the input to every layer, and whose output is subsequently written back into the memory for use by later layers. For AttnRes, this memory stream is a growing cache of explicit layer representations. For mHC, it is an expanded residual stream. Building on this view, we propose Linear Depth Memory (LDM), which formulates information retrieval across depth as a regression problem solved using recursive least squares. The resulting architecture propagates three streams across depth: the standard residual stream, a linear associative memory stream, and an inverse covariance stream. For high-throughput training and inference, we propose a hardware-aware implementation of LDM that reduces peak activation memory and memory traffic. LDM consistently achieves the lowest perplexities among PreLN, mHC and AttnRes baselines at the 400M and 1.5B parameter scales, alongside competitive zero-shot accuracy.

papers.title_en: Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld
papers.evidence: 针对规范博弈的带可验证保证的约束强化学习缓解方法
papers.tldr: 强化学习智能体只优化给定奖励，当该奖励只是真实目标的代理时，可能出现规范博弈，即表面高分却背离真实目的。本文构建清洁机器人网格世界，让智能体可选择真正清除污垢或向廉价传感器隐藏污垢，并用标准DQN复现代理奖励被完全博弈的现象。随后提出约束强化学习方法，对利用代理/真实目标差距的具体行为施加惩罚，从而在最终策略中消除博弈并显著恢复真实目标表现。作者还推导并验证代理奖励、真实奖励与成本信号间的精确核算恒等式，为缓解措施提供可验证保证。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor's proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, penalizing the specific behaviors through which the agent exploits the gap, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. We further derive and empirically verify an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, true reward, and our cost signal for this environment, showing that the cost signal measures the proxy/true gap exactly rather than merely tracking it, and yields a deterministic guarantee under a hard-constrained variant of the method.

papers.title_en: Embodiment-Aware Inference-Time Search for Human Reaction Selection in Humanoid Retargeting
papers.authors: Yongpeng Cao, Masahiro Hirano, Yuji Yamakawa
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人具身的人到人形动作重定向与反应选择
papers.tldr: 人形机器人反应学习受限于昂贵数据采集，且为不同本体单独训练反应模型成本高。本文利用人到人形机器人的动作重定向，提出推理时反应搜索框架：从冻结生成模型随机采样多个候选，重定向后联合评估交互质量与本体可行性并择优。实验在保持人类反应质量的同时提升重定向可行性1.61%，且人类空间与G1最优选择不一致率达78.98%。这表明选择反应需显式考虑机器人本体差异，框架无需重训练即可适配不同人形本体。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid robots to learn human behaviors requires expensive data collection, and human-robot interaction data can be even more difficult and costly to collect. Training a specialized reaction model for each humanoid embodiment can also be time-consuming and resource-intensive. Human-to-humanoid motion retargeting provides a more scalable alternative, allowing human-human reaction data to serve as a common motion representation for different humanoid embodiments. However, due to morphological and kinematic differences between humans and humanoid robots, a reaction preferred in human motion space may not be the most suitable one for execution on a particular robot embodiment.   In this work, we propose an inference-time reaction search framework that leverages stochastic sampling from a generative reaction model and jointly considers reaction quality and humanoid embodiment feasibility. Given the observed interaction, our framework generates multiple plausible reaction candidates. Each candidate is retargeted to the target humanoid and evaluated using complementary interaction and embodiment-specific feasibility criteria, allowing candidate selection under the physical constraints of the target embodiment. Since the reaction generator remains frozen, the framework can adapt to different humanoid embodiments at inference time without retraining. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework maintains overall human reaction quality while improving the feasibility of retargeted humanoid reactions across different embodiments. The proposed pipeline improves humanoid retargeting feasibility by 1.61%. Moreover, human-space and G1 best-candidate selections disagree in 78.98% of samples, demonstrating substantial embodiment dependence. Code will be released.

papers.title_en: LiDAR-based Humanoid Navigation in Dynamic, Non-Convex Environments via Spatio-Temporal Safe Corridors
papers.evidence: 耦合倒立摆规划与全身控制的人形机器人运动控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人在动态非凸环境中导航需紧耦合感知、步态规划与全身控制，但现有方法常以简化凸包围丢失自由空间并忽略动态占据预测。本文从LiDAR粒子表示直接构建时空安全走廊，结合LIP规划与WBC控制，实现移动非凸结构周围及内部导航。Digit仿真在24×24平方米场地取得96%成功率，狭窄走廊中迭代多面体生成显著优于单次迭代。该框架无需限制性几何假设，对杂乱、传感噪声、控制延迟和力扰动保持鲁棒。
papers.abstract_en: Navigating humanoid robots through dynamic, non-convex environments requires tightly coupling onboard perception with footstep planning and dynamic locomotion control. Existing methods frequently discard complex free space through simplified convex obstacle bounds and fail to account for real-time dynamic occupancy predictions. This paper presents a real-time framework for humanoid navigation that directly constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors from LiDAR-based particle representations and couples them with Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based planning and Whole Body Control (WBC) to enable navigation around and within moving non-convex structures without restrictive geometric assumptions. Simulations on the Digit humanoid yield a 96% success rate in navigating around and inside moving non-convex obstacles in a 24 by 24 m^2 arena. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed iterative polytope generation significantly outperforms single-iteration baselines in narrow corridors, while evaluations demonstrate robustness to clutter, sensor noise, control delays, and force perturbations.

papers.title_en: PrT-Flow: Probability-Tractable Flow Matching for Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 面向强化学习动作生成的概率可处理流匹配策略
papers.tldr: 扩散模型与Flow Matching能灵活表示多模态机器人动作分布，但许多强化学习算法需要评估每个动作的概率密度，二者难以兼得。PrT-Flow采用可逆的Jacobian-Tractable Transformer，使采样每一步可逆并能高效计算Jacobian行列式，再用Conditional Euler-step Training监督单步位移而非瞬时速度。在Robomimic Lift模仿学习300轮后成功率达96%，与扩散策略参考持平；在OGBench Cube-Triple在线训练60万步后也达96%。该工作证明可逆网络与可处理概率密度既能学习有效机器人策略，也能支撑SAC式actor-critic训练。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models and Flow Matching can represent flexible distributions over robot actions, but many reinforcement learning algorithms also require the probability of each action. We introduce PrT-Flow (Probability-Tractable Flow Matching), which computes probability density while retaining multimodal, multi-step action generation. Its Jacobian-Tractable Transformer (JTT) makes each sampling step invertible and enables efficient computation of its Jacobian determinant. We train these finite steps with Conditional Euler-step Training (CET), which supervises their displacement over one step during sampling rather than their instantaneous velocity. We prove that, under certain assumptions, CET has the same minimizers as fitting the Euler-solver updates of Flow Matching. PrT-Flow achieves 96% success on Robomimic Lift after 300 epochs of imitation learning, matching the diffusion policy reference, and 96% success on OGBench Cube-Triple after 600k online steps. These results demonstrate that invertible networks with tractable probability densities can learn effective robot policies and support SAC-style actor-critic training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sunlight-zero/PrT-Flow .

papers.title_en: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Average-reward Q-learning with Options
papers.authors: Kintan Saha, Ahana Deb, Anders Jonsson, Debabrota Basu
papers.evidence: 平均奖励选项Q学习的有限样本收敛性分析
papers.tldr: 针对平均奖励强化学习中带选项（options）的Q学习缺乏有限样本收敛保证的问题，本文研究inter-option与intra-option两种设定。作者在unichain假设下证明多步选项Bellman算子具有span收缩性，并提出同步估计器构造两种选项Q学习变体。借助扩展的随机逼近框架，首次给出均方意义下tilde O(1/迭代次数)的收敛速率。该结果为层次化、持续性任务的选项Q学习提供了非渐近理论支撑。
papers.abstract_en: We study the finite-sample convergence of Q-learning algorithms for the average-reward formulation of Reinforcement Learning (RL) with options. While options allow temporarily extended and hierarchical actions, the average-reward formulation incorporates continual tasks beyond discounted and episodic RL. We establish the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both the inter- and intra-option settings. First, we prove that both inter- and intra-option Bellman operators satisfy multi-step span contractions under unichain assumptions. Then, we propose synchronous estimators of these multi-step option Bellman operators leading to two variants of option Q-learning. Finally, we extend the stochastic approximation framework to prove convergence rates of these two algorithms under the minimal assumptions used in the literature.

papers.title_en: Provably Efficient Risk-Sensitive Offline Reinforcement Learning via Optimized Certainty Equivalents
papers.authors: Hanzhen Wang, Boxiang Lyu, Zhongxiang Dai, Siyang Gao, Dake Zhang, Shuang Qiu
papers.evidence: 面向不确定性决策的风险敏感离线强化学习
papers.tldr: 风险敏感强化学习需在不确定性与不利结果下决策，固定数据离线学习可避免昂贵交互，但通用理论仍欠缺。本文用优化确定性等价（OCE）统一动态与静态两类风险准则，提出表格悲观值迭代及线性逼近下的悲观最小二乘值迭代。理论上给出依赖效用函数的次线性次优性上界与极小极大下界，显式揭示风险敏感度对学习难度的影响。该工作首次为两类OCE离线RL提供算法和上下界保证。
papers.abstract_en: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes. Learning risk-sensitive policies from fixed datasets is important when additional interaction with the environment is costly. Existing work on risk-sensitive RL focuses on online settings or specific risk measures, leaving a general theoretical understanding of its offline setting underdeveloped. In this work, we investigate efficient offline risk-sensitive RL using the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), a general class of risk measures. We consider two formulations: dynamic-OCE RL, which applies OCE recursively at each step, and static-OCE RL, which applies a single OCE to the cumulative rewards. Under the tabular setting, we develop pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both formulations and establish tight sublinear suboptimality bounds, explicitly capturing how risk sensitivity, encoded by utility functions, affects learning difficulty. Moreover, we establish minimax suboptimality lower bounds to characterize the problem's fundamental limits. To handle large state spaces, we further develop pessimistic least-squares value-iteration algorithms that incorporate the general OCE risk criterion into linear function approximation. We establish utility-dependent sublinear guarantees with explicit dependence on the feature dimension $d$. To our knowledge, we provide the first offline algorithms along with the first upper and lower suboptimality bounds for both dynamic- and static-OCE RL.

papers.title_en: Value as Memory: Online Value-Guided Post-training for General Robot Policies
papers.authors: Wenye Yu, Yijin Chen, Kaiyi Xiong, Wenbo Han, Wendi Chen, Yang Jin, Han Xue, Jun Lv, Cewu Lu, Chuan Wen
papers.evidence: 利用缓存价值函数进行在线强化学习以改进机器人策略
papers.tldr: 通用机器人策略真实后训练受部分可观测与离线反馈延迟困扰。VaM 用价值缓存把近期价值预测当作任务进度记忆来条件化动作，并结合离线演示、离策略干预与在线 rollout 做真实世界强化学习。长时程可变形物体与接触丰富操作中，价值缓存带来 29.4% 平均绝对成功率增益，在线自主学习较匹配离线训练再增 32.8%。该框架实现从离线预热到稀疏奖励在线自主适应的样本高效迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world post-training of generalist robot policies faces two challenges: partial observability makes action selection ambiguous, while offline post-training methods delay feedback from deployment experience. We present Value as Memory (VaM), a framework that addresses these challenges through value caching and online real-world reinforcement learning (RL). Value caching conditions actions on recent value predictions as task-progress memory, while online updates enable timely policy improvement by combining offline demonstrations, off-policy interventions, and on-policy rollouts for sample-efficient adaptation. As a result, VaM transitions from offline RL warmup to online autonomous learning with sparse rewards. Across long-horizon tasks involving deformable objects and contact-rich manipulation, VaM yields a mean absolute success-rate gain of $29.4\%$ with value caching, while achieving a $32.8\%$ gain with online autonomous learning over matched offline training. The evaluated online schedule performs $8\times$ as many policy iterations under the same gradient-step budget, with more than $2\times$ lower recorded time per gradient step with concurrent data collection and training.

papers.title_en: Learning Reachability-Based Safety Representations for Real-Time Robot Navigation in Unknown and Dynamic Environments
papers.evidence: 用神经隐式可达性值函数实现实时安全约束下的机器人控制
papers.tldr: 未知动态环境中，仅靠几何碰撞检查无法保证机器人因速度、朝向和障碍运动导致的安全。论文离线训练神经隐式HJ可达性表示，仅学习值函数中的非负动力学修正，并将其嵌入MPC终端约束与CBF安全滤波器。仿真和地面/空中实验表明，该方法在短预测时域和移动障碍下优于几何及手工基线，并借助顶点树搜索与变分损失扩展到13维状态系统。
papers.abstract_en: Safe robot navigation in unknown, dynamic environments requires more than geometric collision checking: a robot still far from an obstacle may be unable to avoid it because of its speed, orientation, or the obstacle's motion. Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis captures this in a value function whose sign separates states that admit a safe continuation from those where collision is unavoidable, but computing it online for every newly observed environment is too expensive. This dissertation trains neural implicit representations offline on reachability solutions to give optimization-based controllers this information in real time. Since the value function never exceeds the constraint, it equals a directly computed constraint, such as a signed distance, minus a nonnegative dynamics correction. Learning only this correction keeps represented obstacles outside the predicted safe set despite approximation errors. The first two of five methods use the learned function as a terminal constraint in model predictive control, for static local environments and predicted obstacle motion. The next two use it as a barrier candidate in control barrier function safety filters, for static environments and, through pairwise barriers in relative coordinates, for a varying number of moving obstacles. Simulations and hardware experiments on ground and aerial robots show better collision avoidance than geometric and hand-designed baselines, especially for short horizons and moving obstacles. The fifth method replaces the grid-based offline solver, which limits the first four to low-dimensional models. For control-affine dynamics with polytopic inputs, the HJ Hamiltonian is maximized at a vertex, so a parallelizable tree search over vertex inputs can generate training labels. With a loss from the HJ variational inequality, these labels yield barrier candidates for systems with up to 13 states.

papers.title_en: DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Runhua Zhang, Yingjie Niu, Chao Li
papers.evidence: 面向生成式RL策略的统一优势引导策略优化
papers.tldr: 现有强化学习策略已从高斯扩展到扩散与流匹配生成策略，但优化方法常与表示绑定，多步生成中的累积似然比会削弱更新信号。DR-APO将策略改进与策略表示解耦，通过优势引导的目标改进和表示兼容的直接动作拟合，为高斯、扩散与流策略提供统一优化接口。在五个MuJoCo-v5任务中，高斯策略媲美SAC，扩散与流策略取得最佳聚合仅策略性能；NavDP后训练将仿真成功率从70.33%提升至89.55%，真实导航从25%提升至65%。该工作给出跨连续控制与具身导航后统一的策略改进原则。
papers.abstract_en: Policy representations in reinforcement learning have expanded beyond Gaussian policies to diffusion and flow-matching based generative policies. However, existing RL methods remain representation-specific, lacking a unified optimization interface for emerging generative policies. In particular, extending likelihood-based objectives to multi-step generative policies couples optimization to their internal generation process, where accumulated likelihood ratios can weaken the update signal. Meanwhile, generative-policy-specific methods often rely on multi-candidate generation and critic-based selection, improving overall return while providing limited improvement to the policy itself. We introduce DR-APO (Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization), which decouples policy improvement from policy representation through advantage-guided target improvement and representation-compatible direct action fitting, providing a shared optimization principle for Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies. Across five MuJoCo-v5 tasks, DR-APO remains competitive with SAC for Gaussian policies and achieves the best aggregate policy-only performance for both diffusion and flow-matching policies. NavDP post-training improves the Success Rate (SR) from 70.33% to 89.55% in simulation and from 25% to 65% in real-world navigation. These results demonstrate a unified policy-improvement principle across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, from continuous-control learning to embodied-policy post-training.

papers.title_en: Belief Space Planning for Risk Signal Temporal Logic via Mixed-Integer Convex Programming
papers.authors: Shaohang Han, Joris Verhagen, Kaier Liang, Jana Tumova
papers.evidence: 用于信念空间规划的混合整数凸规划
papers.tldr: 机器人需在噪声测量下完成STL时空任务，当测量信息依赖状态时需在信念空间主动降低不确定性，但该问题非凸且梯度法不完备、难获全局最优。本文将Risk STL规划置于高斯信念空间，采用信息形式信念参数化并对信念动力学凸松弛，构造混合整数凸规划。作者证明该MICP可靠且完备，凸松弛保留全局最优输入轨迹。数值仿真验证了方法有效性，为风险时序逻辑下的主动信念规划提供可解且具最优性保证的框架。
papers.abstract_en: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifies robot tasks with spatio-temporal requirements, and its robustness semantics allow planning by trajectory optimization. In practice, robots estimate their state from noisy measurements, and when the information gained from a measurement depends on the state, the robot can actively reduce its uncertainty by planning in the belief space. The resulting problem is, however, generally non-convex, for which gradient-based methods are neither complete nor globally optimal. In this paper, we consider Risk STL (RiSTL) planning in Gaussian belief space and show that an information-form parameterization of the belief, together with a convex relaxation of the belief dynamics, yields a mixed-integer convex program (MICP). We prove that the MICP is sound and complete, and that the relaxation preserves the globally optimal input trajectories. We validate the effectiveness of our method in numerical simulations.

papers.title_en: Controller-Agnostic Runtime Safety Certificates for Tool-Using AI Agents via Data-Driven Robust Reachability
papers.evidence: 基于鲁棒可达性的运行时安全证书
papers.tldr: 工具型AI智能体可执行不可逆操作，但其大模型控制器频繁更换且闭环难以直接分析。作者在控制器与环境间加入运行时过滤器，用日志构建有限受控马尔可夫链，并结合无分布置信域与鲁棒reach-avoid值迭代，给出有界任务内触发不安全条件的概率证书。该证书对满足过滤器的控制器一致成立，换模型无需重算。实验显示真实风险均未超出证书与预算，文件系统沙箱中过滤器保持可靠，并在1050个回合中将七个控制器（含三个开放权重模型）的不安全结果控制为零。
papers.abstract_en: Software agents built on large language models act by issuing tool calls, some of which cannot be undone. To control theory the model is an opaque feedback controller, replaced every few months, whose closed loop cannot be analyzed directly. We propose a runtime filter, or shield, between any such controller and its environment that certifies a bound on the probability of reaching an unsafe condition during a bounded task. Given a predicate abstraction and candidate successor sets, everything else comes from logs: the loop becomes a finite controlled Markov chain, the estimated kernel is surrounded by a distribution-free confidence region, and robust reach-avoid value iteration runs over it. The certificate is probably approximately correct and uniform over controllers respecting the filter, so one model may replace another without recomputation. In all tested datasets the true risk stayed within certificate and budget; in a file-system sandbox the filter stays sound against a hazard the logs barely covered, where a plug-in baseline certifies safety and fails; and it holds seven controllers, three of them open-weights models, to zero unsafe outcomes in 1050 episodes.

papers.title_en: Convex-Analytic View of Query Selection for Safety Verification of Markov Decision Processes
papers.authors: Han Bao, Shinsaku Sakaue, Kazuki Watanabe
papers.evidence: 基于支撑函数的马尔可夫决策过程安全验证凸分析方法
papers.tldr: 针对马尔可夫决策过程安全验证中失败概率外近似需反复选权查询的问题，本文提出统一凸分析框架，用显式误差单位衡量方向违反度。方法以安全区域与外近似的支撑函数差除以单位支撑函数作为得分。证明最大正得分等于包含外近似所需的最小安全区域放大倍数，Euclidean单位可还原旧规则，并导出立方体与安全区域自身两种新规则。实验分析测量规则对验证性能的影响。
papers.abstract_en: Safety verification of a Markov decision process (MDP) asks whether the probabilities of reaching several failure states jointly lie in a convex safe region under every scheduler. Watanabe and Unno (2026) prove safety by refining an outer approximation of the failure probabilities, where each query bounds a nonnegative weighted sum of the probabilities. Their rule selects weights by the largest Euclidean violation. We present a unified framework to measure violation in an explicitly chosen error unit: directions are scored by the support-function gap between the outer approximation and the safe region, normalized by the support function of the unit. We show that the maximal score, when positive, equals the smallest enlargement of the safe region in multiples of that unit that contains the outer approximation. The Euclidean unit recovers the earlier rule; two new rules are generated by the unit cube and the safe region itself. We experimentally evaluate how the choice of measurement rule affects the performance of safety verification for MDPs.

papers.title_en: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
papers.authors: Changyeon Kim, Kimin Lee, Yashraj Narang, Yijie Guo
papers.evidence: 面向机器人基础模型的持续离策略强化学习，跨任务复用actor与critic网络
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型经强化学习后训练可超越示教，但真实部署要求高效学习新任务并保留旧行为。ACCRUE是持续离策略强化学习框架，跨任务继承轻量actor与critic，让每阶段复用先前行为与价值知识。继承的critic仅在当前任务转移上适应并指导actor，同时用少量保留回合的缓存目标蒸馏actor以抑制遗忘。仿真接触丰富装配与真机实验表明后续任务学习加速、遗忘近零，真机训练时间降低31.0%至68.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

papers.title_en: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control for Robotic Arms: Language-to-Code Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Fan Huang, Dezhong Tong, Changyu Chen, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An
papers.evidence: 在MuJoCo中训练强化学习指令策略实现机器人运动控制
papers.tldr: 语言驱动机器人控制中，执行结果难以追溯到指令与程序。ICMC将参数指定、指令生成与代码合成分离，并在UR5e的MuJoCo抓放与字母重塑任务上比较单次生成与ICMC。用GRPO经冻结代码生成器训练指令策略，五程序平均正奖励率由31.6%升至35.3%。日志审计发现奖励标签与几何失败信息不一致，作者提出独立评估协议以区分日志奖励与真实任务成功。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC) separates parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis for language-driven robot control, making execution outcomes traceable to instructions and programs. We compare one-shot generation with ICMC under o1 and o4-mini on cube pick-and-place and letter-reshaping tasks for a UR5e arm in MuJoCo. We then train an open-weight instruction policy by GRPO through a frozen code generator on cube placement onto two- and five-cube letter layouts, averaging the rewards of five programs per instruction. The logged positive-reward rate rose from 31.6% to 35.3% (253/800 to 282/800) between the first and last five training steps. A log audit identifies positive binary labels associated with geometric-failure messages: at least 19 in that run, 18 in the dense-reward run, and 5 in the run with one program per instruction. In one case, all five rewards were 1.0 while the log reports a 0.9515 m miss against a 0.05 m tolerance; the verdict came from the program's own output stream. We distinguish logged reward rates from independently verified task success and report descriptive results for each configuration's single training trajectory. We introduce an independent evaluation protocol that checks task completion against fixed specifications, separating robot control from success assessment to support reproducible evaluation.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
papers.evidence: 面向具身预测与规划的記憶增强隐世界模型
papers.tldr: 潜空间世界模型在具身规划中可扩展，但存在表征崩塌、计算开销大和长时程能力弱的问题。本文提出记忆增强的潜世界模型，在JEPA式预测中加入内容可寻址记忆库，直接从观测学习多时间尺度的高层表征，并用自适应层归一化调制预测。为防崩塌并提升记忆利用率，设计了槽多样性与时间均衡两项损失。在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher和OGBCube上，以轻量架构取得最优性能，长时程规划优于传统潜世界模型。
papers.abstract_en: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.
